rationale.approved: 2026-11-07 direct user adoption: streb=努ˢ, vind=包ⱽ, steg=支ˢ, fotel=肘椅, deprim=消沉. streb shares 努 with pen because both express effort toward a goal. vind shares 包 with bandaĝ and pak while preserving swaddling and bandage senses. steg shares 支 with apog while retaining the technical reinforcement/spacing meaning in annotations. fotel retains the armrest feature with 肘 plus 椅 and shares 肘 with kubut; 肘椅 is a project compression of the Japanese armchair name, not claimed to be the standard Chinese name. deprim uses the established Chinese 消沉 for loss of vigor and discouragement, preserving psychological/medical and causative senses. Current spellings are meaningful; selection favors reuse and character inventory reduction, including the one-stroke increase for deprim. Body strokes 8/14/15/19/16 to 7/5/4/19/17, total 72 to 52. Exclusive 奋,裹,撑,扶,沮 removed, no new characters. Existing pen/pak/bandaĝ/apog identifiers and all other root displays stay unchanged. Preserve all root decomposition, detailed glosses, short JA/ZH/KO annotations, F/band and fixed legacy. Current and fixed original legacy only; no intermediate edition or old-spelling aliases.

migration_notice: Only current streb, vind, steg, fotel and deprim change. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
